what: committed production k of each design's implemented input decoupling (the package network is closed at it); written by tcpmt_design_comparison.py commit-k from a decoupling chain run, read by tcpmt_design_record.py

m36.rule: the implementable interleaving + ring option of least nominal k_eq: clock plans of one n-phase group (i_rows<n>+c_ring, i_latin<n>*+c_ring) or of two interleaved n-phase groups (i_dual<n>+c_ring, 2n phases); other group sizes (blk9, dual9) are alternatives and i_spread<n^2> is the limit, not candidates

ball_rms.basis: port model at the S0 case's 48-V current (I_total_dc_A); I_ball_A = the worse of the worst-ball RMS and the DC peak x k_eq (the closure criterion)

bga_closure.rule: per-ball current = max(DC peak x k_eq, worst-ball RMS of the port model (Z1)) <= 1.5 A, at most 220 balls per rail

basis.Z1: max(verified DC peak x k_eq, worst-ball RMS of the port model)
basis.Z2: verified DC peak x k_eq (no port model of Z2's feed: the closure rule alone)

m36.source: decoupling chain (tcpmt_decap_circuit/placement/framework) on the design's own package network and S0 case (etm_Z1_HV_S0_h1.1_r21.json, mesh rung r21), 2026-11-19
